title: Unregistered Exit Portal Causes Game Progression Soft-Lock at Level Finish
explanation: Player reached exit terminus coordinates (7486.56, 159.97) at frames 3594 and 3739, but goal.found remained false across all snapshots and no portal_entered event was emitted. Violates lifecycle progression contract (Portal2D.gd:L11-L16), leaving player stranded.

title: Score Monotonicity Anomaly: Erroneous Score Deductions on Pickups
explanation: At frames 810, 908, 1039, and 1050, collecting collectibles after reaching 500 points triggered unexpected_score_change anomalies decrementing score by 10 instead of adding points. Violates state monotonicity invariant (PlayerData.gd:L36-L43 set_score), corrupting cumulative player score.

title: Collectible Collision Active During Picked Animation (Duplicate Pickup)
explanation: At frame 1061, player bounced through Coin14 during its 0.4s picked animation, triggering duplicate_pickup_attempt anomaly. Violates collectible idempotency contract (Coin.gd:L27-L35), as collision shape remained enabled while awaiting queue_free().
